## Wrong place?

Send these to <https://ninjatrader.com/support/> instead of GitHub:

- Account access, or a locked account.
- Authentication and login failures.
- Funding and billing.
- An order fill or an execution you dispute.
- Anything that needs an account lookup.

A GitHub issue is for a defect in a skill or in a tool the skill calls.
Report the defect here only when someone can reproduce it without access to your account.

**Do not include account numbers, order IDs, or fill details in this
report.** Describe the problem in general terms instead.

## Client

Which MCP client did you use (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, another
client)?

## Skill

Which skill did you run?

## What you asked for

Paste the prompt or command you gave the skill.

## Expected behavior

What did you expect the skill to do?

## Actual behavior

What did the skill do instead? Paste any error message.
